title: Bar held at both ends with two axial loads: support reactions

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: Timoshenko, Strength of Materials, Part I, 3rd ed. 1956, p. 26, problem 10 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Vertical bar of 10 in held against axial and lateral translation at both ends (nodes at 0, 4, 7, 10 in), 1000 lb downward at 7 in and 500 lb downward at 4 in; A = 1 in^2, Iz = 0.0001 in^4 (the page's input), E = 30e6 psi. First-order analysis. Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
